3198.title: Android PWA icon clipping was not reproduced from shipped assets
3198.rootCauseOneLine: No repository root cause was established: all shipped maskable glyphs remain inside the guaranteed safe zone and match the corresponding install glyph scale.
3198.proposedFix: Do not change assets without a device reproduction; next capture the Android, browser, selected manifest/icon, and first-launch rendering on a clean install.
3198.caveats: No Android emulator or device tooling was available. The two clean runs verify repository manifest and mask-safety data, not the reporter's exact browser and device rendering path.
